github.body: ### Pre-Submission Checklist - [x] I have checked the existing/closed issues to ensure this issue has not already been reported. - [x] I am using the latest supported version of the browser. - [x] I have tried disabling all browser extensions/add-ons to rule out interference from these. - [x] I have tried clearing the browser cache and cookies. - [x] I have checked with a new profile and the issue still occurs. - [x] I have provided detailed step-by-step instructions on how to reproduce the issue. - [x] I have included relevant screenshots or console outputs. - [x] I have checked that this problem is not occurring in the latest version of Firefox. - [x] This issue is specific to this browser and does not occur in other browsers. ### Bug Summary On older versions Pip used to work on side panel tabs but on recent versions this functionality completely broke and now attempting to press the pip button from a side panel website will bring up a blank pip pop-up window that cannot be closed at all until the browser is restarted. tested with both yt music and yt as these are the websites i've used this workflow with since i started using floorp ### Reproduction Steps 1. Add a video website on the sidebar and try to pip a playing video from the pip overlay on the video ### Expected Behavior Pip pop out window opens with the video playing on it like on a normal tab ### Actual Behavior Blank pip pop out window opens - cannot be closed even if you press the x(close) button on it. Pressing the pip button on the sidebar spawns more of these un-closable pop ups. Video continues playing on the side panel ### Screenshots ### Browser Version Version 12.16.4@153.0 ### Operating System Ubuntu Linux ### Additional Context This issue came about around the same time another issue i posted about came up namely the Ctrl + F bug on side panel websites(which was closed as solved but i can confirm ctrl + F to find on side panel still isn't working on latest version)

comments.body: It behaved the same way in Windows 11. I was able to close it by right-clicking.
